Policy · Last updated August 11, 2026

Publisher terms

Review status

Draft for owner and qualified legal review before public launch.

Approval

Publishers apply through a reviewable workflow. Approval does not guarantee publication of any product or version. Staff approval and an offline marketplace signature are required for publication.

Rights and provenance

Publishers must hold the rights required to distribute every included file and must disclose third-party material and its license. Secret keys, stolen content, malware, undeclared binaries, and misleading compatibility claims are prohibited.

Executable content

Content and declared C# assemblies may be submitted. Native plugins are prohibited in 0.3.1. Server validation never executes package code, analyzers, source generators, install scripts, native binaries, or arbitrary build hooks.

Support and security

Publishers must maintain accurate release notes and compatibility, respond to security notices, and publish corrections as new immutable versions. A security-revoked version may be blocked immediately.
